in_marathi.name: Harbir
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harbir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Har (God) + Bir (Light): Harbir represents the divine light that guides and protects us. In Hindu mythology, Harbir is a form of Lord Vishnu and is believed to bestow wisdom and courage upon his devotees.
